design: Each pair: identical old Frame, equal bytes, 2-5 native links per observed path in BOTH cases. Separate copies versus two hardlinked names. Target role and execution order randomized. Observed collateral SHA-256 change is the target; no setup labels go to fit. New native identities/names/content in fresh cohort. 32 training and 128 fresh transitions. Frozen rule and predictions journaled before dispatch. One attempt only.
candidate: Simple exhaustive eq/lt/le same-channel comparison stumps over anonymous raw integer channels; training majority in leaves, tie=False; training error then enumeration order selects. Grammar and sensor channels are human-provided.
baselines: Old Frame majority baseline: each matched pair has exactly equal inputs and opposite targets, so no deterministic memoryless old-Frame predictor can exceed 50% on these balanced paired inputs. Ablation refits search excluding the entire selected raw channel (not just one equivalent comparison).
measurement: Accuracy denominator=128 fresh native transitions. No statistical population/general-mechanics claim. GREEN requires all 8 gates. Missing/unsupported native setup or interrupted execution=INVALID, not a permitted retry. Save original evidence either way.
limitations: Not old LinkGraph gate reproduction or repair
Not superiority over feature search: this IS feature search
Raw file identity is a privileged sensor added by humans
Only one native volume: inode comparison need not generalize across devices
No active experiment selection, arbitrary concept invention, or AGI claim
Same trusted supervisor measures and dispatches; not external attestation
No mutation of D4 or production; OFF retained
